mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MEMBER_ACCOUNT ( ACCOUNT_ID, ORGAN_ID, APP_ID, ORGAN_NAME, INOUT_MODE, NAME, CNAME, TYPE, CLIENT_ID, CLIENT_SECRET, AES_KEY, AES_IV_KEY, SERVER_IP, SERVER_TYPE, SERVER_URL, SERVER_CONF1, SERVER_CONF2, SERVER_CONF3,CURR_COUNT, CONF_LIMIT, IS_ADMIN, IS_SINGLE, IS_DISABLED, STATUS, CREATOR_ID, CREATE_TIME, LAST_TIME, DESCRIPTION ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{organId}, #{appId}, #{organName}, #{inoutMode}, #{name}, #{cname}, #{type}, #{clientId}, #{clientSecret}, #{aesKey}, #{aesIvKey}, #{serverIp}, #{serverType}, #{serverUrl}, #{serverConf1}, #{serverConf2}, #{serverConf3},#{currCount}, #{confLimit}, #{isAdmin}, #{isSingle}, #{isDisabled}, #{status}, #{creatorId}, #{createTime}, #{lastTime}, #{description} )
mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(ACCOUNT_ID) FROM MEMBER_ACCOUNT B
WHERE 1 = 1

SELECT B.ACCOUNT_ID, B.ORGAN_ID, B.APP_ID, B.ORGAN_NAME, B.INOUT_MODE, B.NAME, B.CNAME, B.TYPE, B.CLIENT_ID, B.CLIENT_SECRET, B.AES_KEY, B.AES_IV_KEY, B.SERVER_IP, B.SERVER_TYPE, B.SERVER_URL, B.SERVER_CONF1, B.SERVER_CONF2, B.SERVER_CONF3, B.CURR_COUNT, B.CONF_LIMIT, B.IS_ADMIN, B.IS_SINGLE, B.IS_DISABLED, B.STATUS, B.CREATOR_ID, B.CREATE_TIME, B.LAST_TIME, B.DESCRIPTION FROM MEMBER_ACCOUNT B WHERE 1=1

SELECT B.*,ORG.NAME as inOrganName, APP.NAME as appName FROM MEMBER_ACCOUNT B LEFT JOIN BASE_ORGAN ORG ON B.ORGAN_ID = ORG.ORGAN_ID LEFT JOIN BASE_APP APP on B.APP_ID = APP.APP_ID WHERE ACCOUNT_ID = #{value}

select B.ORGAN_ID,B.NAME,ORGEXT.SNAME,ORGEXT.TEL,ORGEXT.ADDRESS,SO.ORGAN_TYPE, ORGEXT.CONTACT_NAME,ORGEXT.CONTACT_MOBILE,ORGEXT.CONTACT_EMAIL,B.UNION_CODE, B.DEL_FLAG,B.CREATE_TIME,B.LAST_TIME,B.PRIORITY from BASE_ORGAN B LEFT JOIN BASE_ORGAN_EXT ORGEXT on ORGEXT.ORGAN_ID = B.ORGAN_ID LEFT JOIN CORE_ORGAN CORG ON B.ORGAN_ID = CORG.SYSORGAN_ID WHERE 1=1
AND B.NAME like concat(concat('%',#{organName}),'%')
AND B.DEL_FLAG = #{delFlag}
AND CORG.ORGAN_TYPE like concat(concat('%',#{wlType}),'%')
AND (B.NAME like concat(concat('%',#{q}),'%') or ORGEXT.SNAME like concat(concat('%',#{q}),'%') or ORGEXT.ADDRESS like concat(concat('%',#{q}),'%') )
order by B.PRIORITY asc,B.CREATE_TIME DESC

select B.ORGAN_ID,B.NAME,ORGEXT.SNAME,ORGEXT.TEL,ORGEXT.ADDRESS,CORG.ORGAN_TYPE, ORGEXT.CONTACT_NAME,ORGEXT.CONTACT_MOBILE,ORGEXT.CONTACT_EMAIL,B.UNION_CODE,B.DESCRIPTION, B.DEL_FLAG,B.CREATE_TIME,B.LAST_TIME,B.PRIORITY from BASE_ORGAN B LEFT JOIN BASE_ORGAN_EXT ORGEXT on ORGEXT.ORGAN_ID = B.ORGAN_ID LEFT JOIN CORE_ORGAN CORG ON B.ORGAN_ID = CORG.SYSORGAN_ID WHERE 1=1 AND B.ORGAN_ID=#{organId}
